explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/153. f(n) is the infimum, over n-element Sidon sets A, of (1/t)Σ_{1≤i<t}(s_{i+1} - s_i)², where s_1 < ⋯ < s_t enumerates A + A (via orderIsoOfFin). The question whether this tends to ∞ as |A| → ∞ is encoded as Tendsto f atTop atTop, which is the uniform-over-A reading appropriate for 'as |A| → ∞'. The gaps are positive since s is increasing, and the real iInf is bounded below by 0. The open question is stated affirmatively.
